issues.required_change: In §6.3, add the plan-damage rule. Each plan element of a building — a wall run, floor area, door, window, stair, roof bay over a room, or furniture piece — draws ONE threshold in [0, 1], keyed by the building's lineage with the element's id as the creation index (epoch component 0, never re-drawn). The element shows damaged when the building's decay level (0–1, V06, from its existence state and years since abandonment) passes its threshold. Damage is therefore monotone in the level (a higher level's damage ⊇ a lower's), never relocated, and leaves in reverse order when restoration lowers the level. No room, wall, opening or element gains or loses an id (V03 §2.2's identity). Register its concern in §6.1's table (e.g. `plan.damage`, cap 0, geometry-free, non-rerollable by salt) with its readers (§2.6 step 7's damage layer, V03, §8.6).
